meta.name: Raqib Indicator Library (seed)
meta.description: Seed library for Raqib's indicator table and the KPI assistant's retrieval step. Entries marked isStandard=true are aligned with a published framework (names and definitions are paraphrased; for donor submissions use the official wording from the referenced source). Entries with isStandard=false are common-practice indicators written to Raqib's quality checklist and must be adapted to each project.
meta.translationNote: Arabic names are drafts for review by a native-speaking M&E specialist before release.

indicators.name: % of target households with an acceptable Food Consumption Score
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأسر المستهدفة التي لديها درجة استهلاك غذائي مقبولة
indicators.definition: Share of surveyed target households whose Food Consumption Score (7-day recall, eight weighted food groups) falls in the acceptable category.

calculation.numerator: Target households with FCS > 35 (or > 42 where the adjusted high oil/sugar thresholds apply)

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household survey with the WFP FCS module; representative sample of target households; cover lean and harvest seasons where relevant.
indicators.notes: Confirm with the WFP country office or Food Security Sector which thresholds apply in Palestine.

indicators.name: Mean reduced Coping Strategies Index (rCSI) score of target households
indicators.nameAr: متوسط درجة مؤشر استراتيجيات التكيّف المخفّض للأسر المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Average rCSI score, reflecting how often and how severely households used consumption-based coping strategies in the past 7 days.

calculation.formula: Mean of household rCSI scores among surveyed target households

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household survey with the standard rCSI module.

indicators.name: % of target households using crisis or emergency livelihood coping strategies
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأسر المستهدفة التي تلجأ إلى استراتيجيات تكيّف معيشية من مستوى الأزمة أو الطوارئ
indicators.definition: Share of target households that applied at least one crisis- or emergency-level livelihood coping strategy (LCS-FS module) to meet food needs in the recall period.

calculation.numerator: Households whose most severe strategy used is crisis or emergency level

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household survey with the LCS-FS module adapted to the local context.

indicators.name: Number of food-insecure people receiving food or cash assistance
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الذين يعانون من انعدام الأمن الغذائي ويتلقون مساعدات غذائية أو نقدية
indicators.definition: Unique individuals in food-insecure households who received food, voucher or cash-for-food assistance from the project during the period.

calculation.formula: Count of unique individuals (household members of assisted households), de-duplicated across distributions

indicators.meansOfVerification: Distribution lists and beneficiary database, de-duplicated by household ID.
indicators.notes: For EU-funded projects use the GERF 2.32 methodological note wording; sex/gender disaggregation is mandatory.

indicators.name: Average share of household expenditure spent on food among target households
indicators.nameAr: متوسط حصة الإنفاق على الغذاء من إجمالي إنفاق الأسر المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Mean proportion of total household expenditure (cash, credit and in-kind value) used for food over the recall period.

calculation.numerator: Household food expenditure

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household expenditure module (food 7–30 day recall, non-food 30 days–6 months).
indicators.notes: Used in CARI when ECMEN is not available.

indicators.name: % of assisted households reporting they received their full entitlement
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأسر المستفيدة التي أفادت بحصولها على كامل استحقاقها
indicators.definition: Share of sampled assisted households confirming they received the full planned quantity or value of assistance in the last distribution cycle.

calculation.numerator: Sampled households reporting full entitlement received

indicators.meansOfVerification: Post-distribution monitoring phone or in-person survey after each cycle.
indicators.notes: Common post-distribution monitoring practice.

indicators.name: Average volume of water available per person per day in target households
indicators.nameAr: متوسط كمية المياه المتاحة للفرد يومياً في الأسر المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Mean litres of water per person per day available at household level for drinking, cooking and personal hygiene.

calculation.formula: Total household water available per day ÷ household size, averaged across surveyed households

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household survey with container/storage measurement; water trucking or network records for cross-check.

standardReference.code: Water supply standard — minimum 15 l/p/d (aim for 20)

indicators.notes: The Sphere minimum is a standard threshold the AI may cite as a reference target.

indicators.name: % of target households using at least a basic drinking water service
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأسر المستهدفة التي تستخدم خدمة مياه شرب أساسية على الأقل
indicators.definition: Share of target households whose main drinking water comes from an improved source with a round-trip collection time of 30 minutes or less (JMP 'basic' or 'safely managed').

calculation.numerator: Households on the basic or safely managed rung

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household survey using JMP core questions on source and collection time.

indicators.name: % of water samples at point of delivery free of faecal coliforms
indicators.nameAr: نسبة عينات المياه عند نقطة التوزيع الخالية من البكتيريا القولونية البرازية
indicators.definition: Share of water samples tested at the point of delivery with 0 faecal coliform colonies per 100 ml.

calculation.numerator: Samples with 0 CFU/100 ml

indicators.meansOfVerification: Laboratory or field test kit results logged per sampling round.

standardReference.code: Water quality — 0 CFU/100 ml at point of delivery

indicators.name: Number of people with access to improved drinking water and/or sanitation as a result of the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الذين حصلوا على مياه شرب و/أو خدمات صرف صحي محسّنة بفضل المشروع
indicators.definition: Individuals who gained access to an improved drinking water source and/or improved sanitation facility through project-supported infrastructure or services.

calculation.formula: Population served by supported facilities, de-duplicated between water and sanitation

indicators.meansOfVerification: Engineering completion reports, service-area population from the utility or municipality.
indicators.notes: Use the GERF 2.38 methodological note for EU-funded projects.

indicators.name: % of target households with a handwashing facility with soap and water observed
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأسر المستهدفة التي لديها مرفق لغسل اليدين يتوفر فيه الماء والصابون (بالملاحظة)
indicators.definition: Share of visited target households where enumerators observe a handwashing place with both water and soap present.

calculation.numerator: Households with observed facility with water and soap

indicators.meansOfVerification: Observation module within the household survey.
indicators.notes: Observation is preferred over self-reported handwashing, which tends to over-report.

indicators.name: Number of water points constructed or rehabilitated and functional at handover
indicators.nameAr: عدد نقاط المياه التي تم إنشاؤها أو تأهيلها وتعمل عند التسليم
indicators.definition: Water points (taps, wells, tanks, network connections) built or rehabilitated by the project and verified functional at handover.

calculation.formula: Count of water points with signed handover and functionality check

indicators.meansOfVerification: Handover certificates and field functionality checklist.
indicators.notes: Pair with a later functionality-rate outcome indicator if sustainability matters to the donor.

indicators.name: Number of one-year-old children fully immunised in supported areas
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأطفال بعمر سنة واحدة الذين أكملوا التطعيم في المناطق المدعومة
indicators.definition: Children aged 12–23 months who received all vaccines in the national schedule for their age through supported services.

calculation.formula: Count from facility immunisation registers in supported facilities

indicators.meansOfVerification: Ministry of Health / facility immunisation registers.

indicators.name: % of pregnant women in target areas receiving at least four antenatal care visits
indicators.nameAr: نسبة النساء الحوامل في المناطق المستهدفة اللواتي تلقين أربع زيارات رعاية ما قبل الولادة على الأقل
indicators.definition: Share of women who gave birth in the reference period who attended at least four antenatal care visits during the pregnancy.

calculation.numerator: Women with ≥4 ANC visits
calculation.denominator: Women who gave birth in the period in target areas

indicators.meansOfVerification: Facility ANC registers or household survey; align definition with the Ministry of Health.
indicators.notes: Widely used global coverage indicator; confirm the national definition with the Ministry of Health.

indicators.name: Number of consultations provided at supported primary health care facilities
indicators.nameAr: عدد الاستشارات الطبية المقدّمة في مرافق الرعاية الصحية الأولية المدعومة
indicators.definition: Outpatient consultations recorded at facilities receiving project support (staff, supplies or rehabilitation) during the period.

calculation.formula: Sum of consultations from facility registers

indicators.meansOfVerification: Facility HMIS or paper registers.
indicators.notes: Counts consultations, not unique patients — say so in reports.

indicators.name: % of patients reporting satisfaction with services at supported facilities
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المرضى الذين أفادوا برضاهم عن الخدمات في المرافق الصحية المدعومة
indicators.definition: Share of interviewed patients who rate overall service as satisfactory or very satisfactory on a standard exit-interview scale.

calculation.numerator: Patients rating satisfactory or very satisfactory

indicators.meansOfVerification: Exit interviews with a random sample of patients, conducted by staff not providing care.

indicators.name: Number of women of reproductive age, adolescent girls and children under five reached by nutrition interventions
indicators.nameAr: عدد النساء في سن الإنجاب والمراهقات والأطفال دون الخامسة الذين وصلتهم تدخلات تغذوية
indicators.definition: Individuals in these groups reached by nutrition-specific services (screening, counselling, supplementation, treatment) supported by the project.

calculation.formula: Unique individuals reached, from service registers

indicators.meansOfVerification: Nutrition service registers.

indicators.name: Number of students enrolled in supported primary, secondary or tertiary education
indicators.nameAr: عدد الطلبة الملتحقين بالتعليم الأساسي أو الثانوي أو العالي المدعوم
indicators.definition: Students enrolled in schools, programmes or institutions receiving project support in the academic year.

calculation.formula: Enrolment count from school or institution records

indicators.meansOfVerification: School/institution enrolment records; Ministry of Education data.

indicators.name: % of children in supported schools achieving at least minimum proficiency in reading
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأطفال في المدارس المدعومة الذين بلغوا مستوى الحد الأدنى من الكفاءة في القراءة على الأقل
indicators.definition: Share of assessed children in the target grade who reach the minimum proficiency level in reading (Arabic) on a standardised learning assessment.

calculation.numerator: Assessed children at or above minimum proficiency
calculation.denominator: Children assessed in the target grade

indicators.meansOfVerification: Standardised reading assessment administered to a sample of pupils.
indicators.notes: Specify the grade and the assessment tool; a parallel numeracy indicator is common.

indicators.name: Average attendance rate of targeted students
indicators.nameAr: متوسط نسبة حضور الطلبة المستهدفين
indicators.definition: Mean share of school days attended by targeted students over the reporting period.

calculation.numerator: Days attended

indicators.meansOfVerification: School attendance registers.
indicators.notes: Adjust the denominator for school closures caused by emergencies.

indicators.name: Number of teachers trained in the project's pedagogical or psychosocial support package
indicators.nameAr: عدد المعلمين الذين تم تدريبهم على الحزمة التربوية أو حزمة الدعم النفسي الاجتماعي للمشروع
indicators.definition: Teachers who completed at least the minimum required hours of the project training package.

calculation.formula: Count of teachers meeting the completion threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Training attendance sheets and completion records.
indicators.notes: Define 'completed' (e.g., ≥80% of sessions).

indicators.name: % of trained teachers observed applying new teaching practices
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المعلمين المدرَّبين الذين لوحظ تطبيقهم لممارسات تدريس جديدة
indicators.definition: Share of trained teachers scoring at or above the agreed threshold on a structured classroom observation tool.

calculation.numerator: Observed teachers at or above threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Classroom observation checklist administered by trained observers.

indicators.name: Number of children accessing remedial or catch-up learning
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأطفال الذين يتلقّون تعليماً علاجياً أو تعويضياً
indicators.definition: Unique children who attended at least the minimum number of sessions in project remedial or catch-up learning programmes.

calculation.formula: Unique children meeting the attendance threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Learning-space registers.

indicators.name: % of trainees employed or self-employed six months after completing training
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المتدربين الذين يعملون بأجر أو لحسابهم الخاص بعد ستة أشهر من إنهاء التدريب
indicators.definition: Share of training graduates who report paid employment or self-employment (minimum hours per week defined by the project) six months after completion.

calculation.numerator: Graduates employed or self-employed at 6 months
calculation.denominator: Graduates reached by the tracer survey

indicators.meansOfVerification: Tracer survey (phone) of each cohort at six months; report response rate.
indicators.notes: Define the minimum hours/earnings threshold that counts as employment.

indicators.name: Number of people benefiting from institution- or workplace-based vocational training and skills development
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص المستفيدين من التدريب المهني وتنمية المهارات في المؤسسات أو أماكن العمل
indicators.definition: Individuals who completed project-supported TVET or skills development delivered by an institution or in the workplace.

calculation.formula: Unique individuals completing the programme

indicators.meansOfVerification: Training provider completion records.

indicators.name: Number of jobs supported or sustained by the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد فرص العمل التي دعمها المشروع أو حافظ عليها
indicators.definition: Full-time equivalent jobs created or maintained in supported enterprises or through project interventions, including green jobs.

calculation.formula: Sum of FTE jobs created plus jobs sustained, per the donor's counting rules

indicators.meansOfVerification: Enterprise survey and payroll records of supported businesses.
indicators.notes: Counting jobs 'sustained' needs a clear counterfactual rule — use the GERF note.

indicators.name: Average monthly household income of target households
indicators.nameAr: متوسط الدخل الشهري للأسر المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Mean total monthly income (all sources, in ILS) reported by target households, compared with baseline.

calculation.formula: Mean of reported monthly household income; report median as well

indicators.meansOfVerification: Household income module; adjust for inflation when comparing periods.
indicators.notes: Self-reported income is noisy; consider a consumption or asset proxy alongside.

indicators.name: Number of beneficiaries with access to financial services through the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد المستفيدين الذين حصلوا على خدمات مالية من خلال المشروع
indicators.definition: Individuals or MSMEs who opened accounts, received loans, grants with financial linkage, or other formal financial services as a result of the project.

calculation.formula: Unique individuals or enterprises newly accessing a financial service

indicators.meansOfVerification: Partner financial institution records.

indicators.name: Number of MSMEs applying sustainable consumption and production practices
indicators.nameAr: عدد المنشآت متناهية الصغر والصغيرة والمتوسطة التي تطبّق ممارسات الاستهلاك والإنتاج المستدامين
indicators.definition: Supported micro, small and medium enterprises verified as applying at least one sustainable consumption and production practice (resource efficiency, waste reduction, renewable energy).

calculation.formula: Count of supported MSMEs with verified practice adoption

indicators.meansOfVerification: Enterprise follow-up visits with verification checklist.

indicators.name: % of supported MSMEs reporting increased sales 12 months after support
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المنشآت المدعومة التي أفادت بزيادة مبيعاتها بعد 12 شهراً من الدعم
indicators.definition: Share of supported enterprises whose reported annual sales are higher than at baseline, 12 months after receiving support.

calculation.numerator: Enterprises with higher sales than baseline

indicators.meansOfVerification: Enterprise survey cross-checked with sales records where available.

indicators.name: Number of smallholders reached with interventions to increase sustainable production, access to markets and/or security of land
indicators.nameAr: عدد صغار المزارعين الذين وصلتهم تدخلات لزيادة الإنتاج المستدام و/أو الوصول إلى الأسواق و/أو أمن حيازة الأراضي
indicators.definition: Smallholder farmers and herders who directly received project support aimed at sustainable production, market access or land tenure security.

calculation.formula: Unique smallholders reached

indicators.meansOfVerification: Beneficiary registration and service records.

indicators.name: Agricultural and pastoral land area under sustainable management practices
indicators.nameAr: مساحة الأراضي الزراعية والرعوية المُدارة بممارسات مستدامة
indicators.definition: Area of cropland, orchards or rangeland where supported producers apply sustainable management practices.

calculation.formula: Sum of verified areas; convert dunums to hectares (1 ha = 10 dunums) for EU reporting

indicators.meansOfVerification: Field verification visits and GPS-mapped plots.

indicators.name: % of supported farmers applying at least two promoted agricultural practices
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المزارعين المدعومين الذين يطبّقون ممارستين زراعيتين مُروَّج لهما على الأقل
indicators.definition: Share of supported farmers verified as applying at least two of the practices promoted by the project in the most recent season.

calculation.numerator: Farmers applying ≥2 promoted practices

indicators.meansOfVerification: Farmer survey with field verification of a sub-sample.
indicators.notes: List the promoted practices in the indicator definition.

indicators.name: Average yield of the target crop among supported farmers
indicators.nameAr: متوسط إنتاجية المحصول المستهدف لدى المزارعين المدعومين
indicators.definition: Mean harvested quantity of the target crop per dunum among supported farmers in the reference season.

calculation.formula: Mean of (harvest kg ÷ cultivated dunums) across surveyed farmers

indicators.meansOfVerification: Post-harvest farmer survey; crop-cut sample where feasible.
indicators.notes: Yields vary with rainfall; record seasonal conditions as an assumption.

indicators.name: Number of people receiving focused psychosocial or psychological care
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الذين يتلقّون رعاية نفسية اجتماعية أو نفسية مركّزة
indicators.definition: Individuals who received at least the minimum number of sessions of a focused (individual, family or group) psychosocial or psychological intervention.

calculation.formula: Unique clients meeting the session threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Case management records (aggregated; never export personal data).

indicators.name: % of supported individuals with improved functioning score
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الأفراد المدعومين الذين تحسّنت لديهم درجة الأداء الوظيفي
indicators.definition: Share of clients whose score on a validated functioning measure improved between intake and follow-up.

calculation.numerator: Clients with improved functioning score at follow-up
calculation.denominator: Clients with intake and follow-up scores

indicators.meansOfVerification: Validated tool (e.g., WHO-DAS, as cited in the IASC framework) administered by trained staff at intake and follow-up.
indicators.notes: Goal-level in the IASC framework; used as an outcome indicator at project level.

indicators.name: % of target group members who report feeling safe in their community
indicators.nameAr: نسبة أفراد الفئة المستهدفة الذين يفيدون بشعورهم بالأمان في مجتمعهم
indicators.definition: Share of surveyed target group members who report feeling safe or very safe in specified places (home, route to school/work, community spaces).

calculation.numerator: Respondents reporting safe or very safe

indicators.meansOfVerification: Community survey with protection-trained enumerators; FGDs to explain changes.
indicators.notes: Safety perceptions can fall because of events outside project control — record context.

indicators.name: Number of people benefiting from legal aid
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص المستفيدين من المساعدة القانونية
indicators.definition: Individuals who received legal counselling, representation or assistance through project-supported legal aid services.

calculation.formula: Unique clients served

indicators.meansOfVerification: Legal aid case registers (aggregated).

indicators.name: Number of people benefiting from interventions countering sexual and gender-based violence
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص المستفيدين من التدخلات الرامية إلى مكافحة العنف الجنسي والعنف القائم على النوع الاجتماعي
indicators.definition: Individuals reached by prevention, response or survivor-support services addressing SGBV.

calculation.formula: Unique individuals reached; report prevention and response separately

indicators.meansOfVerification: Service records held by specialised GBV actors; only aggregated, anonymised figures in Raqib.
indicators.notes: Follow GBV data protection protocols; never store survivor-level data in Raqib.

indicators.name: % of participating caregivers demonstrating improved knowledge and skills in positive parenting
indicators.nameAr: نسبة مقدّمي الرعاية المشاركين الذين أظهروا تحسناً في معارف ومهارات التربية الإيجابية
indicators.definition: Share of caregivers whose post-programme score on a parenting knowledge and skills tool exceeds their pre-programme score by the agreed margin.

calculation.numerator: Caregivers meeting the improvement threshold
calculation.denominator: Caregivers with pre and post scores

indicators.meansOfVerification: Pre/post questionnaire.

indicators.name: Number of displaced people and host community members protected or assisted
indicators.nameAr: عدد النازحين وأفراد المجتمعات المضيفة الذين تمّت حمايتهم أو مساعدتهم
indicators.definition: Refugees, internally displaced persons, returnees and host community members who received protection or assistance from the project.

calculation.formula: Unique individuals assisted, by status

indicators.meansOfVerification: Beneficiary database de-duplicated across services.

indicators.name: % of women participants reporting a joint or sole role in household economic decisions
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المشاركات اللواتي يفدن بأن لهن دوراً منفرداً أو مشتركاً في القرارات الاقتصادية للأسرة
indicators.definition: Share of women participants who report making, alone or jointly, decisions on major household purchases and use of income.

calculation.numerator: Women reporting sole or joint decision-making on the defined decisions

indicators.meansOfVerification: Survey module on decision-making, interviewed privately by female enumerators.
indicators.notes: Interview women privately; consider do-no-harm risks.

indicators.name: % of positions in supported community committees held by women
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المقاعد التي تشغلها نساء في اللجان المجتمعية المدعومة
indicators.definition: Share of members (and separately, leadership roles) in project-supported committees who are women.

calculation.numerator: Committee positions held by women

indicators.meansOfVerification: Committee membership records.
indicators.notes: Pair with a qualitative measure of meaningful participation.

indicators.name: Number of women supported to start or grow a business
indicators.nameAr: عدد النساء اللواتي تم دعمهن لبدء مشروع تجاري أو تنميته
indicators.definition: Women entrepreneurs who received a complete support package (training plus grant, mentoring or market linkage) from the project.

calculation.formula: Unique women completing the package

indicators.meansOfVerification: Programme records and grant agreements.

indicators.name: Number of grassroots civil society organisations benefiting from or reached by project support
indicators.nameAr: عدد منظمات المجتمع المدني القاعدية التي استفادت من دعم المشروع أو وصلها
indicators.definition: Community-based and grassroots CSOs that received grants, capacity development or other direct support.

calculation.formula: Unique organisations supported

indicators.meansOfVerification: Grant and training records.

indicators.name: Number of government policies developed or revised with civil society participation
indicators.nameAr: عدد السياسات الحكومية التي تم إعدادها أو مراجعتها بمشاركة المجتمع المدني
indicators.definition: Policies, strategies or regulations formally adopted or revised where documented civil society participation took place with project support.

calculation.formula: Count of policies with evidence of adoption and CSO participation

indicators.meansOfVerification: Official publications, consultation records, KIIs with officials.

indicators.name: % of residents in target localities satisfied with local government services
indicators.nameAr: نسبة السكان في المناطق المستهدفة الراضين عن خدمات الهيئات المحلية
indicators.definition: Share of surveyed residents who rate the quality of selected local government services as good or very good.

calculation.numerator: Residents rating services good or very good

indicators.meansOfVerification: Citizen satisfaction survey or community scorecard.

indicators.name: Number of supported institutions with an improved organisational capacity score
indicators.nameAr: عدد المؤسسات المدعومة التي تحسّنت درجة قدرتها المؤسسية
indicators.definition: Supported institutions whose score on the project's organisational capacity assessment improved by the agreed margin between baseline and follow-up.

calculation.formula: Count of institutions meeting the improvement threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Organisational capacity assessment tool applied at baseline and endline with evidence review.
indicators.notes: Self-assessment scores tend to drop as awareness grows — triangulate with evidence.

indicators.name: Number of young people completing life-skills or employability training
indicators.nameAr: عدد الشباب الذين أتمّوا تدريباً على المهارات الحياتية أو مهارات التوظيف
indicators.definition: Young people (age band defined by the project, e.g., 15–29) who completed at least the minimum share of training sessions.

calculation.formula: Unique youth meeting the completion threshold

indicators.meansOfVerification: Attendance and completion records.

indicators.name: % of youth participants in employment, education or training six months after completion
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الشباب المشاركين الملتحقين بعمل أو تعليم أو تدريب بعد ستة أشهر من إنهاء البرنامج
indicators.definition: Share of youth graduates who are employed, self-employed, enrolled in education or in training six months after completing the programme.

calculation.numerator: Graduates in employment, education or training at 6 months
calculation.denominator: Graduates reached by the tracer survey

indicators.meansOfVerification: Phone tracer survey; report response rate.

indicators.name: % of youth participants who took part in a community or civic initiative in the past three months
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الشباب المشاركين الذين شاركوا في مبادرة مجتمعية أو مدنية خلال الأشهر الثلاثة الماضية
indicators.definition: Share of youth participants who report taking part in at least one organised community, volunteer or civic activity in the past three months.

calculation.numerator: Youth reporting participation

indicators.meansOfVerification: Participant survey; FGDs on quality of engagement.

indicators.name: % of assisted people who know how to give feedback or make a complaint
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المستفيدين الذين يعرفون كيفية تقديم ملاحظة أو شكوى
indicators.definition: Share of sampled assisted people who can name at least one project feedback or complaint channel.

calculation.numerator: Respondents naming at least one channel

indicators.meansOfVerification: Post-distribution or beneficiary feedback survey.
indicators.notes: Offer in every humanitarian framework.

indicators.name: % of complaints and feedback responded to within the agreed timeframe
indicators.nameAr: نسبة الشكاوى والملاحظات التي تمّ الرد عليها ضمن الإطار الزمني المتفق عليه
indicators.definition: Share of logged complaints and feedback items that received a response or resolution within the timeframe set in the feedback mechanism SOP.

calculation.numerator: Items responded to within the timeframe

indicators.meansOfVerification: Complaint and feedback log.
indicators.notes: Sensitive complaints (e.g., misconduct) follow a separate confidential procedure.

indicators.name: % of assisted people who report that the assistance met their priority needs
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المستفيدين الذين يفيدون بأن المساعدة لبّت احتياجاتهم ذات الأولوية
indicators.definition: Share of sampled assisted people who report the assistance addressed their most important needs completely or mostly.

calculation.numerator: Respondents answering completely or mostly

indicators.meansOfVerification: Beneficiary perception survey.

indicators.name: % of assisted people who report being treated with respect by staff and volunteers
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المستفيدين الذين يفيدون بأنهم عوملوا باحترام من قبل الموظفين والمتطوعين
indicators.definition: Share of sampled assisted people who report always or mostly being treated with respect during their interactions with the project.

calculation.numerator: Respondents answering always or mostly

indicators.meansOfVerification: Beneficiary perception survey administered by people not delivering the assistance.

indicators.name: % of assisted people who report being consulted on the design or adjustment of assistance
indicators.nameAr: نسبة المستفيدين الذين يفيدون بأنه تمت استشارتهم في تصميم المساعدة أو تعديلها
indicators.definition: Share of sampled assisted people who report having been asked for their views on what assistance they need or how it is delivered.

calculation.numerator: Respondents reporting consultation

indicators.meansOfVerification: Beneficiary perception survey and FGDs.

indicators.name: Number of unique people directly reached by the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الفريدين الذين وصلهم المشروع بشكل مباشر
indicators.definition: Individuals who directly received at least one project service or good, counted once regardless of how many services they received.

calculation.formula: Count of unique beneficiary IDs with at least one service record

indicators.meansOfVerification: Raqib beneficiary and service records (computed automatically).
indicators.notes: Raqib can compute this directly from the Beneficiary and BeneficiaryService tables.

indicators.name: Number of people gaining access to electricity through the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الذين حصلوا على الكهرباء بفضل المشروع
indicators.definition: People in households or served by facilities that gained new or improved electricity access (grid or off-grid, including solar) through project support.

calculation.formula: Household members of connected households plus users of served facilities, per GERF counting rules

indicators.meansOfVerification: Installation and connection records.

indicators.name: Renewable energy generation capacity installed
indicators.nameAr: القدرة المركّبة لتوليد الطاقة المتجددة
indicators.definition: Rated capacity of renewable energy systems (e.g., solar PV) installed with project support.

calculation.formula: Sum of rated capacity of commissioned systems (convert kW to MW for EU reporting)

indicators.meansOfVerification: Commissioning certificates.

indicators.name: Greenhouse gas emissions avoided
indicators.nameAr: انبعاثات غازات الدفيئة التي تمّ تجنّبها
indicators.definition: Estimated annual tonnes of CO2 equivalent avoided as a result of project-supported renewable energy or efficiency measures.

calculation.formula: Energy generated or saved × grid emission factor, using the donor's stated methodology

indicators.meansOfVerification: Metered generation data and a documented emission factor.

indicators.name: Number of people gaining internet access through the project
indicators.nameAr: عدد الأشخاص الذين حصلوا على الإنترنت بفضل المشروع
indicators.definition: Individuals who gained new access to internet connectivity (household, community centre, school) through project support.

calculation.formula: Unique users of newly connected points, per GERF counting rules

indicators.meansOfVerification: Connection and user registration records.

indicators.name: Unemployment rate among young people in target governorates
indicators.nameAr: معدل البطالة بين الشباب في المحافظات المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Share of the youth labour force (age band as published by PCBS) in the target governorates that is unemployed, as reported in official labour force statistics.

calculation.formula: As published by PCBS for the relevant governorates and period

indicators.meansOfVerification: PCBS Labour Force Survey publications.
indicators.notes: Impact-level context indicator; the project contributes but cannot attribute changes.

indicators.name: Prevalence of food insecurity in target governorates
indicators.nameAr: نسبة انتشار انعدام الأمن الغذائي في المحافظات المستهدفة
indicators.definition: Share of households classified as food insecure in the target governorates according to the most recent official or sector-wide food security assessment.

calculation.formula: As published by the food security assessment used (e.g., PCBS/Food Security Sector)

indicators.meansOfVerification: Most recent official or Food Security Sector assessment; cite publication and year.
indicators.notes: Impact-level context indicator; confirm which assessment is current before use.
